## Team Visualizations

```{=html}
<!-- Each teammate: agree as a team on who's making which plot before anyone starts, so
     no two people create the same visualization. Then add your own section below with
     your name and your one plot. -->

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)
```

### \[Sid Chevvan\] — \["BoxPlot"\]

```{r}
# Make your agreed-upon plot here, e.g.:
### \[Sid Chevvan\] — \[Body mass of penguins vs species\]
penguins |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = species, y = body_mass_g)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(
    title = "Body mass of penguins based on species",
    x = "Species",
    y = "Body Mass"
  )
  
### \[Carter\] — \[Number of Penguins Observed per Year\]

```{r}
# Make your agreed-upon plot here, e.g.:
# penguins |> ggplot(aes(x = species, y = body_mass_g, fill = species)) + geom_boxplot()
penguins |>
  count(year, species) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = n, color = species)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(2007, 2008, 2009)) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Count", color = "Species")
```
